title: Influence Bounds for Arbitrary Product Measures

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description: Every bounded function of low interaction degree on a finite product space with an arbitrary product measure has a coordinate whose influence is at least a fixed power of its variance, with constants independent of all atom probabilities; consequently low-degree functions are approximated by shallow deterministic decision trees. Self-contained proofs.
